profile.name: THACHANG GREEN ENERGY PUBLIC COMPANY LIMITED
profile.businessType: The Company engages in the generation and distribution of electricity from renewable energy sources. Currently, its operations are categorized into three main business segments as follows:1) Biomass Power Plants;2) Municipal Solid Waste (MSW) Power Plants; and3) Management of Biogas Power Plants.
profile.address: 159, Moo 3, Tambon Tha Chang, Amphoe Tha Chang Surat Thani 84150
profile.dividendPolicy:
The Company has policy to pay dividend to shareholders at a minimum of 30 percent of net profits after deducting corporate income taxes, legal reserve allocation, and obligations under the terms of the loan agreement considering from the Company's separate financial statements. However, the Company may consider paying dividends differently from the
established policy depending on business performance, financial position, liquidity, and the necessity of funds to manage operations and business expansion, including the economic conditions.
